description: This file defines resource detectors for process-related attributes in the OpenTelemetry SDK, including process ID, executable name and path, command arguments, owner, and runtime information.

classes.name: processExecutablePathDetector
classes.description: Detects the full path of the process executable.

classes.name: processCommandArgsDetector
classes.description: Detects the command-line arguments of the process.

classes.name: processOwnerDetector
classes.description: Detects the owner of the process.

classes.name: processRuntimeNameDetector
classes.description: Detects the runtime name used to compile the process.

classes.name: processRuntimeDescriptionDetector
classes.description: Detects a description of the runtime environment.

methods.name: Detect
methods.description: Returns a Resource describing specific process attributes, implemented for each detector class.
